lessons.title: Practice String Concatenation Indexing
lessons.description: Finish two functions. combine(a, b) joins the strings with + (combine("py", "thon") is "python"). get_first_and_last(s) returns the first character plus the last character (get_first_and_last("hello") is "ho"). The test checks that combine("py", "thon") equals "python"; get_first_and_last("hello") equals "ho".

lessons.title: Practice ID Badge Formatter
lessons.description: Finish format_badge. Format user details into an ID badge string: "ID: " + name.upper() + " (" + role + ")". The test checks that format_badge("Alice", "Admin") equals "ID: Alice (Admin)".
learning_objectives: This step joins the parts with the separator, using parts holding linen.
lessons.solution_code:
def format_badge(name, role):
    return "ID: " + name + " (" + role + ")"

lessons.description: wrap_string(s, char) must surround s with char on both sides, returning char + s + char using string concatenation. The test checks that wrap_string("test", "*") equals "*test*".
learning_objectives: This step adds the base reading to the slot where the mark sits, using text holding maple.

def wrap_string(s, char):
